text_block_list.text:
I'm at a winning concert rehearsal with
Smart
Falcon.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hmhm. ♪ Hmmm! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Wink! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
My spirits always soar when I see Smart
Falcon on
stage.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hehe! ☆ Thank you!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Honestly, Trainer, the look on your
face...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It's only a rehearsal. If you keep this up,
I'm going
to worry about you when it
comes time for the
real thing! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: But I do know how you feel. After all...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It's my eternal goal to stand onstage
wearing such
a wonderful costume. ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I've packed all of my feelings into this
outfit. Even
the diamond pattern has a
meaning.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Do you know why I chose diamonds,
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: That's right! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And what's more, diamonds come from
mines,
right?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
When it's first mined from the earth, a
diamond
just looks like a rock, but it
shines brilliantly once
it's been polished
by a jeweler.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
That's why I want you and all my fans to
polish me
until I shine too!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list:
Let's make sure you sparkle and charm
everyone!

text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Ehehe... Now I'm itching to get to
work
right away! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Seeing as I've already got my signature
racewear
on, why don't we go out and
put on a street
performance? ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Thank you for coming to my surprise

performance, everyone!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: You're so cute, Falco!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text: That outfit looks so good on you!
text_block_list.name: Spectators

text_block_list.text:
Thank you! ☆ With all of your support,
I'm gonna
shine even more!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And I want to say thanks to my trainer
too, for
finding me when I was still just a
diamond in the
rough! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna do my very best to shine even
brighter,
so please keep supporting
me! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Okay!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Talking about this kind of thing makes
me want to
take off running. ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff... ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Whew... That feels good! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
When I was a kid, the sight of idols on
stage and
racers on the track was so
thrilling, it made my
heart skip a beat.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I want to be able to sparkle like that, so
I can
charm people just like they
charmed me.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I tell her how captivated I was when I
saw her
running earlier.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer! Let's keep working
hard
together...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
So I can shine with all my heart and soul
in my
races and concerts! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Amidst the warm applause, Смарт Фалкон
and I
reaffirm our determination.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And someday, I'll become an Umadol
more
charming than any jewel! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
